description: This file contains a database migration script for the Superset project, specifically to upgrade pivot table heatmap slices to a new format by modifying their JSON parameters.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing the 'slices' table with id, viz_type, and params fields.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs a database migration to update pivot_table_v2 slices by adding conditional formatting based on existing parameters.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: No downgrade logic implemented; slices cannot be reverted to previous state.
